summary: Endovia Health Sciences filed an 8-K disclosing a September 18, 2026 Letter Agreement with C/M Capital Master Fund, LP, under which the investor committed at least $1 million to support CannEpil regulatory and commercialization work. The company closed an initial $510,000 secured convertible note with a $576,271 principal amount, net of $66,271 original issue discount, convertible at the lower of $1.75 or $0.01 above the conversion-date closing price, maturing September 18, 2027. Separately, 3,629,250 shares were issued under the existing September 19, 2025 ELOC for $808,829.42. This is ordinary financing, not a special situation.
